real.description: The real part of the complex tensor. Must be half, float or double.
constraints: Must be half, float or double.
Input real and imag tensors must have the same shape.

imag.description: The imaginary part of the complex tensor. Must be same dtype as :attr:`real`.
constraints: Must have same dtype as real.
Input real and imag tensors must have the same shape.

out.description: If the inputs are ``torch.float32``, must be ``torch.complex64``. If the inputs are ``torch.float64``, must be ``torch.complex128``.

constraints: Input real and imag tensors must have the same shape.
